sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: The owner phase contract requires every unconfirmed RuntimeException to remain a failed stop, with no confirmed-index advance and no release of later owners. The catch covers exactly IOException/LifecycleException/RuntimeException; Error is never caught and nested fatal graphs are rethrown before fixed redacted IOException. Original6 and newSTOP007 independently cover ordinary and fatal graph/phase behavior. This native lifetime boundary needs the stated closed category, not arbitrary exception swallowing.

sourceAnchors.message: Avoid using literals such as 1 in if statements
sourceAnchors.reason: The independent STOP007 fixture enumerates three graph forms:0 direct cause,1 suppressed through a cause cycle,2 SQL next. Literal1 selects the specific cyclic graph oracle, not a business threshold or externally configurable policy. Both Runtime and Lifecycle catalog forms retain Error identity and the same phase; original expectations unchanged.
